title: ANDS Studio — Sign in / create a workspace
walkthrough:
You land on a single card. At the top is the product mark "ANDS Studio" with a dot icon, then the heading "Sign in" and one line of grey text: "Your clients' dossiers are isolated per workspace." Below are labeled fields "Email" (placeholder "ra@company.example") and "Password", then a primary button "Sign in →" beside a plain-text button "New here? Create a workspace", with a smaller "Forgot password?" button below. The primary button stays disabled until both fields are filled and reads "Working…" while submitting; pressing Enter in the password field also submits. At the bottom, separated by a thin rule, sits a single link: "Enterprise SSO on the roadmap →". No other roadmap or "not yet available" copy appears on the sign-in card.

Signing in against an account with multi-factor authentication enabled reveals an "Authenticator code" field (placeholder "6-digit code") with helper text saying this account has "multi-factor authentication" (a hover-defined term) enabled and to enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator app. A wrong code returns "That code didn't verify — codes rotate every 30 seconds; try the current one."

Clicking "New here? Create a workspace" swaps into signup mode: the heading becomes "Create your workspace", with a "What is a workspace?" hover term. A "Who are you filing for?" choice offers "Your own company" or "On behalf of clients (CRO)", and the subtext, company-name label, and placeholder adjust accordingly ("Your company name" / "Acme Therapeutics Inc." versus "Client company name" / "Northbridge Regulatory CRO"). As you type a password, live helper text shows "At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers.", counts down remaining characters if short, and flips to "✓ Meets the password rules." Buttons become "Create workspace →" and "Have an account? Sign in".

Choosing "Forgot password?" changes the heading to "Reset your password" and explains a one-time code (expires in 15 minutes) will be issued. You enter your email and click "Send me a code →". A notice box states this is a demo environment with no outbound email — in production the code is emailed and never displayed — and the code stays hidden behind a "Reveal demo code" button (toggling to "Hide"). Fields "One-time code" (placeholder "8-digit code") and "New password" follow; "Set new password →" returns you to sign-in with "Password updated — sign in with your new password." A "Back to sign in" button is always present. Errors appear in a red notice box.

After signing in, you reach the workspace, which carries a shared top bar: the "ANDS Studio" mark, then a row of icon chips — "Journey", "Dossiers", "Portfolio", "Registry", "Correspondence", "Help" — with the current page highlighted. At the right sits a user chip showing your initial in an avatar, your email, your workspace name, and a caret. Clicking it opens a dropdown that repeats your email and workspace and offers "Account & security" (shield icon) and "Sign out" (a red item). Signing out shows a brief "Signed out" toast and returns you to the login card.

The Account & security page stacks cards. "Who you are here" shows your email, workspace (isolated to this workspace), and role, with a "What can each role do? ▼" expander revealing a per-role permission table — your role outlined and badged "Your role" — plus a note distinguishing owner (the platform vendor), workspace admin, and the internal "tenant admin" name. "Multi-factor authentication" offers "Set up authenticator app →" (a secret with "Copy setup link", then a 6-digit verify step; nothing is enforced until the code verifies). "Workspace MFA policy" shows "Required for all members ✓" or "Optional per member", with a toggle for admins. "Password & sessions" states the 10-character rule, reset via "Forgot password?", and 12-hour sessions. "Deployment & data residency" says ANDS Studio is self-hosted, cross-workspace reads are refused at the API, and SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM and SIEM streaming are not yet available — each acronym hover-defined — echoed by a closing "Roadmap — not yet available" card with target quarters and "Nothing below works yet."
